🇺🇦🇪🇺 The EU allocates 180 million euros for the expansion of ammunition production in Ukraine. The European Defence Fund has allocated 180 million euros for the expansion of ammunition and missile production capacities in Ukraine. The initiative aims to strengthen the production potential both in EU countries and in Ukraine. The main goal of the funding is to reduce the time from placing an order to delivering products to Ukraine. This involves optimizing production processes and improving the efficiency of defense logistics. The total budget of the competition is 180 million euros, and the maximum funding amount for a single project is 30 million euros. Applications will be accepted until October 13, 2026. Participants will need to demonstrate the ability to rapidly increase production and ensure stable deliveries. Particular attention is paid to the creation of joint production sites and lines. A new USGS assessment estimates that the Appalachian region of the eastern U.S. contains 2.3 million metric tons of undiscovered, economically recoverable lithium. That's enough lithium to replace 328 years of imports! Lithium is essential for batteries that power EVs, energy storage systems, electronics, and military technologies. The U.S. still relies heavily on foreign supply, and this research shows that the Appalachians contain enough lithium to help meet the nation's growing needs. Congratulations to the Health Ministers of Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania on 20 years of the Baltic Policy Dialogue — a forum that shows how small countries, working together, can lead big change. Today in Vilnius 🇱🇹, that same spirit is guiding a practical discussion on how investment and reform can strengthen long-term care. I commended Ministers Marija Jakubauskienė 🇱🇹, Hosam Abu Meri 🇱🇻 and Karmen Joller 🇪🇪for the progress already under way - from stronger family medicine and care at home in Lithuania, to mobile palliative care and integrated home care in Latvia, and Estonia’s work to connect health and social services. But ageing and demographic change are accelerating. In the EU alone, public health care costs could rise by 12% without investment in healthy ageing - but stay below 1% with the right investment. The task now – scale what works and build long-term care systems that protect dignity, support families and help people receive care where they live. @LithuaniaHealth | @veselibasmin | @SoMinEstonia | @WHO_Europe | @OBShealth

NITI Aayog participated in the panel discussion on “Building Resilient State Finances for Viksit Bharat,” organised by the Institute of Economic Growth on 4 May at the India Habitat Centre. Prof. Pravakar Sahoo, Programme Director, Economics & Finance (E&F-I), delivered a presentation on the “Fiscal Health Index” as part of the discussions. The event was marked by a keynote address delivered by Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran, Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India, followed by a panel discussion featuring eminent speakers including Mr. A. N. Jha, Member, 16th Finance Commission; Dr. Shamika Ravi, Member, Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister; and Mr. Jayant Sinha, Advisor to the Comptroller and Auditor General and former Deputy CAG. Prof. Sabyasachi Kar, Director, IEG, moderated the discussions and shared his views. The deliberations emphasised the need for institutional strengthening, adoption of data-driven policy frameworks, and enhanced Centre–State coordination to navigate emerging fiscal challenges. The discussion underscored that robust state finances are critical to achieving inclusive and sustainable growth in India’s journey towards Viksit Bharat. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #FiscalHealth #PublicFinance #ViksitBharat #EconomicPolicy

Була доповідь від наших військових і міністра оборони за підсумками квітня. Маємо сильні результати в знищенні окупанта. Росія щомісяця несе значні втрати в особовому складі, і за квітень понад 35 тисяч убитими та тяжко пораненими. По кожному ураженню є чітке підтвердження. Сили оборони України тримають стабільний рівень захисту наших позицій. Завдання – нарощувати результати. Суттєво зросла й кількість мідлстрайків. Зараз уражень на відстані 20+ кілометрів удвічі більше порівняно з березнем та в чотири рази – порівняно з лютим. І буде ще більше. Це пріоритетний напрямок. Абсолютно принципово: треба збільшувати кількість роботизованих місій. За квітень було здійснено більш ніж 10 200 логістичних та евакуаційних завдань НРК, і це суттєвий результат. Але в масштабах фронту потрібно значно більше такої роботи. Відповідно, контрактування НРК, виробництво, постачання у війська повинні постійно зростати. Травень має дати більші показники, і це визначено як цільовий показник для військових та Міністерства оборони. Будемо й надалі нарощувати виробництво всіх типів дронів і роботизованих систем. Дякую кожному, хто щодня вкладається в цей результат. І дякую партнерам за підтвердження фінансової підтримки. Слава Україні!

There was a report from our military and the Minister of Defense on the results from April. We have strong results in eliminating the occupier. Russia suffers significant personnel losses every month – with over 35,000 killed and badly wounded in April. There is clear evidence for each strike. The Defense Forces of Ukraine are maintaining a stable level of protection of our positions. The task is to build on these results. The number of middle strikes has also grown significantly. There are now twice as many strikes at distances of 20+ kilometers compared with March, and four times as many compared with February. And there will be even more. This is a priority area. It is absolutely essential to increase the number of robotic missions. In April, UGVs carried out more than 10,200 logistical and evacuation missions, and this is a significant result. But given the scale of the front, much more of this work is needed. Accordingly, contracting UGVs, their production and supply to the troops must continue to grow. May must deliver higher figures, and this has been set as a target indicator for the military and the Ministry of Defense. We will continue to ramp up production of all types of drones and robotic systems. I thank everyone who contributes to this result every day. And I thank our partners for confirming financial support. Glory to Ukraine!

From sanctions and trade wars to supply chain disruptions, war today operates through both economic and strategic tools, blurring the line between security and economic policy. At the #PIDE Seminar, moderated by Fasi Zaka (@fasi_zaka), Speakers Syed Hassan Akbar and Sarah Zaman (@SarahzTV) highlighted how the world is transitioning toward a multipolar order, where shifting alliances, geoeconomic competition, and policy uncertainty are likely to create prolonged turbulence. The discussion also underscored how digital media and real-time information flows are transforming conflict dynamics, influencing public perception, and complicating decision-making. For Pakistan, the conversation emphasized both opportunity and challenge, from leveraging its role as a regional mediator to addressing structural economic constraints. The key takeaway: strategic relevance must translate into economic strength, requiring reforms, competitiveness, and integration into global value chains. The evolving global order presents risks, but also a critical window for Pakistan to reposition itself in a rapidly changing world. The EU is one of the loudest voices on sustainable fishing globally. It has the regulations, the frameworks, and the institutional weight to back that claim. But a new paper by John J Vachaparambil and Saaz Lahiri of the National Maritime Foundation argues there is a structural contradiction buried inside the EU's external fisheries model — and the Indo-Pacific, particularly the Indian Ocean, is where it is most visible. Reflagging. Opaque vessel ownership. Industrial-scale extraction using Fish Aggregating Devices. The EU's distant-water fleet is significantly larger than officially reported — and the governance gaps that make this possible are not accidental. For India, the consequences are economic, ecological, and strategic — and they touch everything from declining fish catches along its coasts to its ongoing trade negotiations with the EU. Вночі росіяни атакували енергетичну інфраструктуру на Полтавщині. І дуже підло вдарили повторно ракетою, коли на місці вже були працівники ДСНС – ліквідовували пожежу. Станом на зараз відомо про десятки поранених. На жаль, чотири людини було вбито і серед них двоє рятувальників. Це Герой України Віктор Кузьменко, який більш ніж 50 разів ліквідовував наслідки обстрілів, і Дмитро Скриль, який на службі в ДСНС був понад 20 років. Мої щирі співчуття рідним і близьким. Били росіяни й по Харківщині. Четверо людей було поранено. На жаль, одна людина загинула. Мої співчуття. На Дніпровщині атакували критичну інфраструктуру. Троє людей поранено в області. У Павлограді пошкодили ЛЕП, через що тисячі сімей залишилися без світла. Були удари й по Запоріжжю та Київщині, де поранило трьох людей. Загалом головними цілями Росії цієї ночі були обʼєкти нашої енергетичної інфраструктури. Абсолютний цинізм – просити про тишу для проведення пропагандистських святкувань і завдавати таких ракетно-дронових ударів в усі дні перед тим. Кожного дня Росія може припинити вогонь, і це зупинить війну й наші відповіді. Мир потрібен, і для цього потрібні реальні кроки. Україна діятиме дзеркально.

My sincere condolences to their families and loved ones. The Russians also struck the Kharkiv region. Four people were injured. Unfortunately, one person was killed. My condolences. There were also strikes on Zaporizhzhia and the Kyiv region, where three people were injured. Overall, Russia’s main targets overnight were our energy infrastructure facilities. It is utter cynicism to ask for a ceasefire in order to hold propaganda celebrations while carrying out such missile and drone strikes every single day leading up to it. Business and trade will grow exponentially if non-tariff barriers are eliminated, including border delays, non-harmonised standards, and restricted market access. This is the reason we have set ourselves a June 30, 2026 target to ensure all these barriers are removed. Consequently, our Joint Business Council must become the central platform for structured collaboration. Additionally, the Tanzania-Kenya Business Forum will be institutionalised as an annual event to review progress, track implementation, and unlock new opportunities. With President Samia Suluhu Hassan, we addressed the Tanzania-Kenya Business Forum in Dar es Salaam last evening. The event brought together more than 300 business and private sector people. 1. Voting done, results out & all 3 non-BJP-ruled states have seen their incumbents decimated. West Bengal, Tamil Nadu & Kerala have thrown up different insights & lessons. Here are my key takeaways in #NationalInterest. 2. First Bengal. So far, welfare & identity politics worked for Mamata. But, lack of visible development & the old, Left Front-era ‘dadagiri’ finally defeated her. Of course, BJP threw everything at her. But the lesson is, just welfarism & identity politics won’t keep working for you. Not for the 4th time. You need development. 3. West Bengal & Tamil Nadu underline the limitations of regional identity politics. Both Mamata & Stalin built their pitch against Delhi, Hindi domination, & an unfair Centre. Neither appreciated that their young people were impatient. It’s that grievance that led Joseph Vijay to success. 4. Vijay’s rise isn’t unprecedented. Both Sri Lanka & Nepal, the two genuine democracies across our borders, had already seen rank outsiders sweeping aside established parties. The lesson, therefore is, people, especially the young, can get bored with the same old, same old. If a fresh face emerges with new ideas & a clean slate, they’ll take their chances. 5. We’ve seen the marginalisation of the “minority” vote. It’s the logic of Partition that Muslims are scattered even in states where their numbers are significant. Their vote matters if the leaders they trust build coalitions with significant sections of the Hindus. 6. End of the political Left has looked so inevitable one can’t even claim boasting rights. Also, regional parties are on their way out. TMC will struggle to recover. AGP is BJP’s distant hanger-on. Shiv Sena is divided, Akali Dal a shadow of its glory days, NCP, DMK, JD(S) diminished, JD(U) headed into the sunset with Nitish Kumar, BRS broken, & BSP in perpetual hibernation. 7. Besides Kerala, this regionals’ decline is a positive for Congress. Many of these parties had either broken away from it (TMC, YSRCP, NCP), or vacuumed its vote banks (SP, BSP, RJD). If it’s willing to put its head down & be patient, this decline opens up spaces for Congress. Does it have the skill, guts, humility? 8. And finally, you’d err if you credit or blame BJP’s success only on Hindutva. It’s more than that. It’s Hinduised-nationalism. In democracies the world over, hard nationalism is back. Unless BJP’s challengers accept this, they’ll slip further into obscurity. The image of Rahul Gandhi in Nicobar to stop what the wider public opinion would see as a project of great strategic interest, fails this test. Today’s liberalism will have to first pass the test of hard nationalism. 9. Read #NationalInterest: theprint.in/national-interes… Watch #NationalInterest: ￼ youtube.com/watch?v=891ikHt9…

NITI Aayog participated in the panel discussion on “Building Resilient State Finances for Viksit Bharat,” organised by the Institute of Economic Growth on 4 May at the India Habitat Centre. Prof. Pravakar Sahoo, Programme Director, Economics & Finance (E&F-I), delivered a presentation on the “Fiscal Health Index” as part of the discussions. The event was marked by a keynote address delivered by Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran, Chief Economic Adviser to the Government of India, followed by a panel discussion featuring eminent speakers including Mr. A. N. Jha, Member, 16th Finance Commission; Dr. Shamika Ravi, Member, Economic Advisory Council to the Prime Minister; and Mr. Jayant Sinha, Advisor to the Comptroller and Auditor General and former Deputy CAG. Prof. Sabyasachi Kar, Director, IEG, moderated the discussions and shared his views. The deliberations emphasised the need for institutional strengthening, adoption of data-driven policy frameworks, and enhanced Centre–State coordination to navigate emerging fiscal challenges. The discussion underscored that robust state finances are critical to achieving inclusive and sustainable growth in India’s journey towards Viksit Bharat. #PMOIndia #NITIAayog #FiscalHealth #PublicFinance #ViksitBharat #EconomicPolicy

Tracked as CVE-2026-42511, this vulnerability allows a local network attacker to execute arbitrary code as root, granting them complete control over the compromised machine. The core issue resides in how dhclient(8) processes network configuration parameters from DHCP servers. When a device joins a network, it requests IP configuration data. ✨You’ve seen this in every math class: sin(a ± b) = sin a cos b ± cos a sin b sin(2a) = 2 sin a cos a cos(2a) = 1 − 2 sin²(a) 🚨But did you know these formulae came from a Muslim scholar 1000 years ago? Meet Abū al-Wafā al-Būzjānī, the genius who shaped Trigonometry. 📐 Abū al-Wafā Būzhjānī (d. 998) was a Persian Muslim mathematician and astronomer from Khorasan. Born in Būzjān (near Nishapur, Iran), Būzhjānī showed early brilliance in mathematics and geometry. He later moved to Baghdad, then the heart of the Islamic Golden Age, a city of scholars, libraries, and observatories. In Baghdad, he became one of the leading scientists of the House of Wisdom (Bayt al-Ḥikmah). Here, he studied Greek works like Euclid and Ptolemy, and expanded them far beyond their original limits. 📐 His Contributions to Mathematics: He established several trigonometric identities such as [sin(a±b)] in their modern form: {sin(α ± β)= Sinα Cosβ ± Cosα Sinβ} {sin(a + b) = Sin(a)Cos(b) + Cos(a)Sin(b)} {Cos(2a) = 1-2sin²(a)} {Sin(2a) = 2Sin(a) Cos(a)} He compiled tables of sines and tangents at 15° intervals, introduced secant and cosecant, and explored the relationships between all six trigonometric lines. His work made both mathematics and astronomy quantitatively precise. He also studied geometry, arithmetic, and number theory, writing detailed commentaries on al-Khwārizmī and Diophantus. Some sources suggest that he introduced the tangent function, although other sources give the credit for this innovation to al-Marwazi. 🌌 His Work in Astronomy: Abū al-Wafā designed and built a wall quadrant, a large, fixed instrument used to measure celestial altitudes with remarkable accuracy. This invention influenced later observatories across the Islamic world. His masterpiece, Kitāb al-Majisṭī (“The Almagest”), improved upon Ptolemy’s astronomy, described planetary motion, and developed mathematical methods for finding the Qibla direction, the direction of prayer. 🕌 In 997, he participated in an experiment to determine the difference in local time between his location, Baghdad, and that of al-Biruni (who was living in Kath, Uzbekistan). Their result was astonishingly accurate, within about 1 hour of modern calculations. ⏱️

A lot of people think that an air force guy needs to be at the head of the VKS. Putting a pilot in charge of pilots is kind of meh, we don't need or want the air force to be a guild. We don't need a flyboy-in-chief, we need a guy who'll treat the VKS as a strategic instrument of combined-arms warfare. His job is to run a structure that includes not just aviation but also air defense and missile defense, radars, various space systems, and so on. His task is C2, integration of the reconnaissance-strike complex, influencing procurement and production processes, adaptation (Afzalov, from the look of it, didn't do too well adapting air defense to 2026 realities), coordination with the General Staff. In any case, most people were happy with Surovikin in charge of the VKS, and he was as much of a Ground Forces guy as Chaiko. I am not judging either way, I know too little about the people involved and important technical and organizational aspects of the broader system, but the Syrian experience is actually a point in Chaiko's favor (even in the final phase the VKS took out 10–15% of the advancing enemy's manpower when the Syrian army had already scattered every which way, and on top of that they delivered the most beautiful strike of the entire Syrian campaign — four [REDACTED]). Chaiko, as a matter of fact, knows how to use the VKS as a strike-and-support system. From what I have heard, he did quite well in Syria, especially on the organization/coordination fronts. Well, we'll see either way. Something tells me Afzalov was removed for air defence related things, not for mishandling the pilots. Even though Afzalov is a career air defence guy himself. But that isn't always a plus, when a person is used to doing the same thing for decades and then suddenly everything has to change. Two activists, Saif Abu Keshek and Thiago Avila, were separated from the others and taken to Israel, where they remain detained. Both have reported mistreatment, including being bound, blindfolded and assaulted, with governments including Spain and Brazil condemning their illegal detention. The flotilla is part of an international civilian effort to break Israel’s blockade on the Gaza Strip, where Palestinians are facing genocide and severe restrictions on food, medicine and fuel.

The 24 Solar Terms are a unique Chinese time system that divides the year based on the sun's annual orbit. Start of Summer (li xia), the 7th term of the year, begins on May 5 and ends on May 20 this year. On the day of li xia, many regions in China celebrate the tradition of "Lixia Rice" — a traditional dish. Traditionally, it is made by steaming rice with five-colored beans, symbolizing abundance and well-being. Today's recipe embraces seasonal flavors, with savory sausage, sweet peas, carrots, and tender corn stir-fried with rice, creating a fragrant homestyle dish that carries both tradition and the warmth of early summer. chinabound.cn Travel with ease in China, and with meaning. #Lixia #StartOfSummer #LixiaRice #ChinaBound #ASnapshotOfChina

Religious Scholars Are Those Whom Allah Has Made Witnesses to His Oneness: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Addresses Scholarly Gathering in Oslo Oslo, Norway: His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri and Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council of Minhaj-ul-Quran International, participated in a special scholarly session organized in honor of religious scholars at the Islamic Center Minhaj-ul-Quran International, Oslo. On this occasion, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a detailed address on the virtues and responsibilities of religious scholars. He stated that religious scholars are, in reality, those distinguished personalities whom Almighty Allah has made witnesses to His Oneness and truth. He emphasized that their true identity lies in being “Qaim bil-Qist”—those who remain steadfast upon justice and fairness at all times and never deviate from the demands of justice in any matter. While continuing his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam stressed that scholarly discourse must always be based on sound research and strong evidence. Explaining the proper order of scholarly reasoning, he stated that priority must first be given to the Holy Qur’an, followed by the Prophetic Hadith (peace and blessings be upon him), then Ijma (consensus) and Qiyas (analogical reasoning), and finally Ijtihad and personal opinion, as maintaining this order is essential for preserving academic and scholarly standards. During the session, Shaykh-ul-Islam also responded to various scholarly and research-based questions raised by the participants. The gathering was attended by a large number of scholars from different schools of thought, including Mufti Tahir Aziz, Hafiz Sadaqat Ali Qadri, Hafiz Safdar Ali, Qari Ansar Ali Qadri, Mufti Zubair Tabassum, Allama Arshad Zia, Haroon Qayyum, Allama Kaukab Noorani, Allama Muhammad Jameel Mortensrud, Allama Najeeb-ur-Rehman Naz, Allama Naseer Ahmad Noori, Allama Noor Ahmad Noor, Syed Nehmat Ali Shah, Syed Firasat Ali Bukhari, Qari Muhammad Aslam, Qari Israr Ahmad, Qari Jahangir Drammen, Qari Mahmood-ul-Hasan, Qari Noor Ali Sialvi, Syed Zawar Hussain Naqvi, Qari Rehmat Ilahi, Syed Shamshad Rizvi, Allama Hamid Farooq, Allama Nasir Ali, Qari Shiraz Madani, Syed Hasnain Gilani, Qari Ahmad Bilal Shah, Allama Inam Awan, Qari Zia-ul-Hasnain, Masoom Zubair, Syed Hassan Rizvi, Allama Saleem Alvi, Allama Javed, Allama Bashir Ahmad, Allama Ateeq-ur-Rehman, Allama Abid Kashmiri, Faisal Qayyum, Syed Bilal Imtiaz Shah, Qari Syed Farid, and many other scholars and spiritual leaders from Oslo and surrounding areas. Representatives from MQI Norway were also present, including Imam and Director MQI Norway Allama Muhammad Iqbal Fani, Afzal Ansari (Ameer-e-Tehreek), Awais Ejaz Ahmed (President), Chaudhry Mushtaq Ahmed (President Rabita Committee and Vice President MQI), Zartash Bashir (Vice President), Hassan Bashir (General Secretary MQI), Atif Rauf (Finance Secretary), Ata-ul-Mustafa Mahmood (Joint Secretary), Pervaiz Nisar (Head, House of Representatives MQI), Arfan Ansari (President MQI Oslo), Sheikh Iftikhar (Vice President), Muhammad Nazim Ali (General Secretary), Fahad Nisar (Joint Secretary), and Executive Board members including Rauf Hussain, Atique Sial, Shuaib Saleem, and Sabir Hussain.

#CARICOMYouthSpotlight 🌟Young people from the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) made strong contributions on issues of regional and global significance when they represented the Community at the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC) Youth Forum from 14–16 April 2026 in New York, USA. 📍 ECOSOC Youth Forum 🗓 14–16 April 2026 📌 United Nations Headquarters, New York 👥 Youth Ambassadors and representatives from CARICOM Member States and Associate Members, alongside senior regional officials responsible for youth affairs, engaged in intergenerational discussions on development priorities and inclusive decision-making, underscoring a shared commitment to ensuring that young people are active contributors to regional and global development processes. 💡 A central highlight was a CARICOM-led session, where youth examined regional development challenges through five Sustainable Development Goals: 💧 SDG 6 – Clean Water and Sanitation ⚡ SDG 7 – Affordable and Clean Energy 🏗 SDG 9 – Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure 🏙 SDG 11 – Sustainable Cities and Communities 🤝 SDG 17 – Partnerships for the Goals 🌊 During the session, CARICOM youth highlighted issues specific to Small Island Developing States, including the need for resilient water systems, expanded renewable energy access, and infrastructure capable of withstanding environmental and economic shocks. Their contributions drew on lived experiences and emphasized solutions grounded in community knowledge and regional cooperation. 🗣 Discussions also explored meaningful youth participation in policymaking, sharing practical approaches to strengthening youth councils, institutionalising engagement, and integrating youth voices into national frameworks. 🇺🇳 As part of their programme, the delegation visited the CARICOM Permanent Observer Mission to the United Nations for an informal exchange with Leslie Wade. The engagement allowed youth representatives to reflect on advocacy pathways and compare national mechanisms supporting youth participation across the Region. #CARICOM #YouthVoices #ECOSOCYouthForum #SDGs #CaribbeanYouth

Today in Brussels, my engagement with European partners focused on elevating the #EU–IFAD partnership into a more strategic, investment-led alliance, one that safeguards development impact, protects economic stability and food systems in an increasingly volatile global context. At the @Europarl_EN Committee on Agriculture and Rural Development, we discussed how the Middle East crisis is transmitting into Europe through rising fertilizer and energy prices. With nitrogen fertilizer prices up by 30–60%, risks are immediate: higher production costs, pressure on yields and sustained food inflation across European markets. These shocks are not contained. When small-scale farmers, who produce up to half of the world’s food, reduce inputs, the effects cascade across global supply chains, tightening markets and increasing costs for consumers and businesses, including in the EU. This is where the EU–IFAD partnership becomes strategic. @IFAD operates at the first mile, where shocks are absorbed and where targeted investment stabilizes production, protects livelihoods and secures supply chains. The €70 million joint EU–IFAD response to the Ukraine crisis demonstrates in practice, how reducing dependency on external inputs and building resilience at scale protect crucial food supply chains. My meetings with individual MEPs and the @UN Resident Coordinator and Country team reinforced this approach and the importance of stronger UN–EU alignment on water, food security and food systems, and the need for greater coordination across institutions to deliver systemic, country-level impact. #FinancingTheFirstMile

Dr. Saon Ray (@SaonRay), Senior Visiting Professor, ICRIER (@ICRIER) highlighted that recent global developments, including rising energy prices and geopolitical tensions ,are significantly amplifying uncertainties in global supply chains. She noted that factors such as tariff escalations, supply concentration in critical sectors, and increasing policy unpredictability have heightened vulnerabilities for both India and ASEAN economies. Focusing on resilience strategies, she emphasised the importance of energy diversification, particularly for import-dependent economies, and the need to reduce reliance on single suppliers across sectors such as oil, gas, and critical minerals. She also underscored the growing relevance of financial and policy coordination, including exploring local currency trade mechanisms, alternative payment systems beyond SWIFT, and greater harmonisation of standards and regulations between India and ASEAN. Hoje assinei a Medida Provisória do Novo Desenrola Brasil. O programa abre uma mobilização nacional de 90 dias para que brasileiros endividados possam renegociar suas dívidas, limpar o nome e recomeçar. Criamos o Desenrola Famílias, voltado para quem recebe até 5 salários mínimos, com descontos que podem chegar a 90%, juros reduzidos e possibilidade de parcelamento em até 48 meses; o Desenrola FIES, que permite a renegociação das dívidas estudantis em atraso com condições especiais de pagamento; e também medidas para micro e pequenas empresas voltarem a ter acesso ao crédito. Quem aderir ao programa ficará automaticamente impedido de acessar jogos de apostas e bets pelo período de um ano. Agora começa uma mobilização nacional. É a oportunidade de recomeçar, limpar o nome e fazer a economia continuar girando. 🎥Audiovisual/PR Video

Al vertice della Comunità Politica Europea a Yerevan abbiamo adottato una dichiarazione congiunta sul contrasto alla migrazione illegale, condivisa dai leader di 33 Stati: governo.it/sites/governo.it/… Già al vertice di Copenaghen avevamo individuato linee d’azione fondamentali per perseguire un approccio lungo l’intera rotta migratoria, sottolineando la necessità di agire contro i trafficanti, garantire la solidità dei quadri normativi nazionali e internazionali, accelerare i rimpatri, sviluppare nuove partnership, gestire efficacemente la migrazione a monte e contrastare la strumentalizzazione della migrazione. Concordando sulla necessità di sostenersi reciprocamente in questi sforzi. Oggi, di fronte ai significativi spostamenti di popolazione in Sudan, nel Corno d’Africa e nell’intero Medio Oriente, queste priorità restano più che mai attuali. Abbiamo quindi deciso - anche sulla base delle lezioni apprese dalla crisi migratoria del 2015 e per evitare una situazione analoga in futuro - di rafforzare il coordinamento su più fronti: condivisione delle informazioni, interventi umanitari mirati, collaborazione con organizzazioni internazionali, dialogo intensificato con i Paesi di origine e di transito, sicurezza e protezione delle frontiere terrestri e marittime, lotta alla criminalità organizzata, regole solide e non aggirabili, accordi efficaci per i rimpatri e un’azione sistemica che utilizzi tutti gli strumenti disponibili per coordinare gli sforzi internazionali e proteggere l’integrità delle nostre frontiere. Negli ultimi mesi sono stati compiuti progressi concreti, con nuove misure e partenariati e risultati nel contrasto ai trafficanti. Continueremo a lavorare con determinazione sulle sfide migratorie globali, anche in vista del prossimo vertice in Irlanda. L’Italia farà la sua parte, con serietà e responsabilità.

Mayyun Island: a discreet strategic chokepoint at the heart of major rivalries in the Red Sea Mayyun Island, located at the heart of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, is now emerging as a pivotal node in the strategic rivalries shaping the Red Sea. This volcanic outcrop is drawing increasing attention from regional and international powers due to its capacity to control, or disrupt, one of the world’s most critical maritime trade routes. Since early April, several Western intelligence services have requested satellite imagery acquisitions from Airbus Defence and Space, specifically targeting Mayyun. This renewed interest comes amid heightened tensions between anti-Houthi factions, particularly between the internationally recognized Yemeni government (backed by Riyadh) and forces affiliated with Tareq Saleh, nephew of Ali Abdullah Saleh. Long supported by Abu Dhabi, Tareq Saleh is now attracting Washington’s attention, signaling a possible realignment of external backing. A revealing episode illustrates these frictions: on April 1, military transport aircraft reportedly attempted to land on the island but were prevented from doing so by pro-Saudi forces. While this account was officially denied, OSINT analyses nevertheless confirmed the suspicious passage, the previous evening, of an Ilyushin Il-76 (registration TL-ATD), which circled above Mayyun before heading back toward Africa. The aircraft is operated by Invicta Air Cargo, a Central African company with structural ties to Emirati security networks, notably through Gewan Holding, which is close to Hamdan bin Zayed al-Nahyan, brother of President Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan. Technical connections between the two entities (including the reuse of digital infrastructure and transfers of aviation assets) suggest operational continuity. Notably, a few days after flying over Mayyun, the aircraft traveled from Fujairah to the Israeli Nevatim airbase, pointing to broader, and potentially coordinated, logistical circuits. On the ground, the control dynamics over the island have evolved. Initially, Abu Dhabi had been developing discreet air infrastructure there, progress of which was still visible in commercial satellite imagery in 2025. However, since early 2026, the UAE appears to have withdrawn. This shift is part of a broader reassertion of control by Riyadh over local forces (notably those of the Southern Transitional Council), thereby consolidating its direct influence. Currently, control of Mayyun rests on a combination of Tareq Saleh’s forces and a significant Saudi contingent, particularly deployed around the island’s airstrip. However, the aforementioned aerial incident suggests that coordination between these actors remains imperfect, if not openly strained. Moreover, several local sources indicate a deepening of security cooperation between Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Israel on the island. Narratives disseminated by the Houthis had already, as early as February, pointed to joint projects aimed at transforming Mayyun into a forward strategic platform. The objective appears clear: to establish a foothold capable of containing, or countering, any attempt by the Iran-backed Houthis to blockade the strait, echoing recurring tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Finally, the gradual withdrawal of the UAE from its insular positions in Yemen (notably Socotra and Mayyun) now seems nearly complete. Religious Scholars Are Those Whom Allah Has Made Witnesses to His Oneness: Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri Addresses Scholarly Gathering in Oslo Oslo, Norway: His Eminence Shaykh-ul-Islam Dr. Muhammad Tahir-ul-Qadri and Prof. Dr. Hassan Mohiuddin Qadri, Chairman Supreme Council of Minhaj-ul-Quran International, participated in a special scholarly session organized in honor of religious scholars at the Islamic Center Minhaj-ul-Quran International, Oslo. On this occasion, Shaykh-ul-Islam delivered a detailed address on the virtues and responsibilities of religious scholars. He stated that religious scholars are, in reality, those distinguished personalities whom Almighty Allah has made witnesses to His Oneness and truth. He emphasized that their true identity lies in being “Qaim bil-Qist”—those who remain steadfast upon justice and fairness at all times and never deviate from the demands of justice in any matter. While continuing his address, Shaykh-ul-Islam stressed that scholarly discourse must always be based on sound research and strong evidence. Explaining the proper order of scholarly reasoning, he stated that priority must first be given to the Holy Qur’an, followed by the Prophetic Hadith (peace and blessings be upon him), then Ijma (consensus) and Qiyas (analogical reasoning), and finally Ijtihad and personal opinion, as maintaining this order is essential for preserving academic and scholarly standards. During the session, Shaykh-ul-Islam also responded to various scholarly and research-based questions raised by the participants. The gathering was attended by a large number of scholars from different schools of thought, including Mufti Tahir Aziz, Hafiz Sadaqat Ali Qadri, Hafiz Safdar Ali, Qari Ansar Ali Qadri, Mufti Zubair Tabassum, Allama Arshad Zia, Haroon Qayyum, Allama Kaukab Noorani, Allama Muhammad Jameel Mortensrud, Allama Najeeb-ur-Rehman Naz, Allama Naseer Ahmad Noori, Allama Noor Ahmad Noor, Syed Nehmat Ali Shah, Syed Firasat Ali Bukhari, Qari Muhammad Aslam, Qari Israr Ahmad, Qari Jahangir Drammen, Qari Mahmood-ul-Hasan, Qari Noor Ali Sialvi, Syed Zawar Hussain Naqvi, Qari Rehmat Ilahi, Syed Shamshad Rizvi, Allama Hamid Farooq, Allama Nasir Ali, Qari Shiraz Madani, Syed Hasnain Gilani, Qari Ahmad Bilal Shah, Allama Inam Awan, Qari Zia-ul-Hasnain, Masoom Zubair, Syed Hassan Rizvi, Allama Saleem Alvi, Allama Javed, Allama Bashir Ahmad, Allama Ateeq-ur-Rehman, Allama Abid Kashmiri, Faisal Qayyum, Syed Bilal Imtiaz Shah, Qari Syed Farid, and many other scholars and spiritual leaders from Oslo and surrounding areas. Representatives from MQI Norway were also present, including Imam and Director MQI Norway Allama Muhammad Iqbal Fani, Afzal Ansari (Ameer-e-Tehreek), Awais Ejaz Ahmed (President), Chaudhry Mushtaq Ahmed (President Rabita Committee and Vice President MQI), Zartash Bashir (Vice President), Hassan Bashir (General Secretary MQI), Atif Rauf (Finance Secretary), Ata-ul-Mustafa Mahmood (Joint Secretary), Pervaiz Nisar (Head, House of Representatives MQI), Arfan Ansari (President MQI Oslo), Sheikh Iftikhar (Vice President), Muhammad Nazim Ali (General Secretary), Fahad Nisar (Joint Secretary), and Executive Board members including Rauf Hussain, Atique Sial, Shuaib Saleem, and Sabir Hussain.

पुणे, नागपूर, नाशिक, संभाजीनगरच्या विकासाला वेग, महानगर प्रदेशांच्या विकास आराखड्यांना मंजुरी मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज सह्याद्री अतिथीगृह, मुंबई येथे पुणे, नागपूर, छत्रपती संभाजीनगर, नाशिक महानगर प्रदेश विकास प्राधिकरणांची बैठक पार पडली. पुणे महानगर विकास प्रदेश प्राधिकरणाने संरचनात्मक (स्ट्रक्चरल) आराखडा तयार करताना प्रत्यक्ष जागेवर जाऊन पाहणी करावी. तसेच येत्या 6 महिन्यात हा आराखडा तयार करावा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. तसेच पीएमआरडीएच्या 2026–2027 च्या ₹4628.85 कोटींच्या अर्थसंकल्पास मान्यता देण्यात आली. यासह नागरिकांना वेळेत आणि जलद गतीने सेवा देता यावी यासाठी जमीन विल्हेवाटीच्या दैनंदिन कामकाजाचे अधिकार थेट महानगर आयुक्तांना देण्याचा महत्त्वपूर्ण निर्णय या बैठकीत मंजूर करण्यात आला. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, कात्रज-येरवडा ट्वीन टनेलच्या कामासाठी स्वतंत्र विशेष उद्देश वहन संस्था निर्माण करावी. त्यासाठी पुणे महापालिकेने पुढाकार घ्यावा. तसेच पीएमआरडीए व पुणे महापालिकेने संयुक्तपणे कार्यवाही करावी. तसेच पुणे महापालिकेमध्ये गेलेल्या 23 गावांचा विकास आराखडा तयार करावा. तत्पूर्वी तेथे प्रथम संरचनात्मक आराखडा तयार करावा. या अर्थसंकल्पात ₹2918.81 कोटी इतका सर्वाधिक निधी अभियांत्रिकी विभाग (1 व 2) साठी पायाभूत सुविधा आणि विकासकामांसाठी मंजूर करण्यात आला आहे. यामुळे पुणे महानगर क्षेत्रातील रिंग रोड, मेट्रो प्रकल्प, रस्ते विकास, कात्रज–येरवडा ट्विन टनेल, लोणावळा स्कायवॉक या कामांना गती मिळणार आहे. तसेच जमीन व मालमत्ता विभागासाठी ₹970.76 कोटींचा भांडवली खर्च नियोजित करण्यात आला आहे. यंदाचा अर्थसंकल्प ₹3.55 कोटींच्या शिलकीचा आहे. नाशिक महानगर प्रदेश विकास प्राधिकरणाच्या ₹236 कोटींच्या अर्थसंकल्पास मंजुरी नाशिक महानगर प्रदेश विकास प्राधिकरणाच्या दुसऱ्या वार्षिक सभा पार पडली. या सभेत सन 2026-27 च्या सुमारे ₹236.07 कोटींच्या अंदाजित अर्थसंकल्पास मान्यता देण्यात आली. तसेच प्राधिकरणाच्या हद्दीतील प्रस्तावित नाशिक रिंगरोड (परिक्रमा मार्ग) लगतच्या दोन्ही बाजूस टप्प्याटप्प्याने नगररचना योजनेच्या माध्यमातून बाह्य वळण रस्ता प्रभाव क्षेत्र म्हणून विकसित करण्यासही मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी मान्यता दिली. यावेळी सन 2025-26 च्या सुमारे ₹454.5 कोटींच्या सुधारित अर्थसंकल्पासही मान्यता देण्यात आली. एनएमआरडीएच्या कार्यालयासाठी स्वतःची इमारत खरेदी करण्यासही मान्यता देण्यात आली. नाशिक महानगर प्रदेश विकास प्राधिकरणाने तयार केलेल्या भूखंड विल्हेवाट नियमावली व जाहिरात फलक धोरणास मंजुरी देण्यात आली. तसेच शासकीय जमिनींच्या व्यवस्थापनासाठी सल्लागार संस्था नेमणे, तसेच विकास योजनांअंतर्गत जमीन वापर नकाशा तयार करण्यासाठी टप्प्याटप्प्याने निधी अदा करण्यास मंजुरी देण्यात आली. नागपूर शहराभोवती बाह्यवळण रस्ता, 4 वाहतूक बेट, आंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार आणि आर्थिक केंद्रास मंजुरी नागपूर शहराभोवती This Wall Street insider just exposed the secret doomsday escape plans of AI billionaires. 1 in 3 billionaires has a fully funded plan to abandon civilization when things collapse. They meet their pilots at Oakland airport, board a Gulfstream 650, fly to New Zealand, and disappear into a bunker that cost tens of millions to build. And this isn't some conspiracy theory. There's literally PROOF: Sam Altman told The New Yorker he stockpiles guns, gold, potassium iodide, antibiotics, batteries, water, and gas masks from the Israeli Defense Force. He owns a patch of land in Big Sur he can fly to when society breaks down. His backup plan is flying with Peter Thiel to Thiel's compound in New Zealand. Peter Thiel became a New Zealand citizen in 2011 after spending only 12 days in the country. He bought a 477-acre estate for $13.5 million and submitted plans for a bunker-style compound embedded into a hillside with a 1,082-foot glass-lined guest lodge for 24 people. Mark Zuckerberg is building a 5,000 square foot underground shelter beneath his $270 million compound in Hawaii. Blast-resistant doors made of metal and concrete, its own energy and food supplies, and an escape hatch accessible by ladder. Every construction worker signed an NDA and different crews were forbidden from speaking to each other. Larry Page, co-founder of Google, quietly disappeared to Fiji during the pandemic. He reportedly bought at least one private island in the Mamanuca archipelago. When local media reported his presence, Fijian authorities ordered the article taken down. Scott Galloway sat with one of these billionaires who walked him through his entire exit strategy step by step. His response: "You don't think your pilots are going to kill you and fuck your wife? You don't think the people in New Zealand are going to come take the rich guy's shit?" But here's the thing that really matters... These are the SAME people building AI. The same founders telling Congress that AI will cure cancer have already decided they're leaving when it goes sideways. Galloway confirmed a secondhand account from someone close to one of these AI CEOs. The CEO admitted he believes there's a 7 to 10% chance AI results in a catastrophic event for humanity. And he doesn't care because being the person who summoned this intelligence is "more consequential than whatever happens." These billionaires don't use public healthcare. They have concierge medicine delivered to their living room. Their kids attend $75,000 per year academies while public schools spend $10,000. They fly private. They have private security instead of police. Galloway's words: "The 0.1% are no longer invested in the well-being of America. They've totally dissociated because they're sequestered from it." And the incentives to reach that level are so extreme that founders will make ANY decision necessary to get there. Galloway called it the Darth Vader pipeline. Every tech CEO follows the same arc: Sam Altman was "the gay son we all wanted." Soft spoken, testifying before Congress about safety. Now he's subpoenaing nonprofits that criticize OpenAI and telling people to stop complaining about energy costs. Galloway on all of them: "These guys would sleep with their cousin for a nickel." The next chosen hero is Dario Amodei at Anthropic. Galloway says he'll follow the exact same path because the system makes it inevitable. Then he dropped his most dangerous prediction: He thinks there's a 1 in 3 chance AI ends up like jet transportation, vaccines, or PCs. Technologies that changed civilization but where NO group of companies ever captured serious shareholder value. The entire airline industry across all of history is at break even. Moderna is down 90%. AI models are converging. Open weight Chinese models are free and a third of corporations are already using them. His prediction: Go short the AI ecosystem. The winner of AI might be us, the users. Not the companies. And if he's right, the domino effect is terrifying... 40% of the S&P is tied to AI. Most GDP growth over the last two years came from AI capex. So if corporations start dropping OpenAI and Anthropic for free Chinese models, the entire market could crash. This is just like the Chinese steel dumping in the 80s: Flood America with cheap AI, kneecap the companies propping up the stock market, then trigger a recession without firing a single shot. The billionaires building AI have escape plans ready. They've detached from society entirely. They know there's a real chance this ends badly and they're building it anyway. Every tech hero turns villain on a shorter timeline. And the financial system is so dependent on AI valuations that one move from China could bring it all down. And we're still trusting these people to self-regulate. What do you think? Video

पंढरपूर तीर्थक्षेत्रासाठी ₹4150 कोटींचा आराखडा मंजूर, 30 महिन्यांत विकासकामे पूर्ण करण्याचे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांच्या अध्यक्षतेखाली आज मंत्रालय, मुंबई येथे पंढरपूर तीर्थक्षेत्र विकास आराखड्यासंदर्भात शिखर समितीची बैठक पार पडली. या बैठकीत ₹4150.46 कोटीच्या सर्वसमावेशक आराखड्यास मान्यता देण्यात आली. पंढरपूर हे राज्यातील सर्व धर्मीयांचे श्रद्धास्थान आहे. त्यामुळे या ठिकाणी येणाऱ्या भाविकास आवश्यक पायाभूत सुविधा उपलब्ध व्हाव्यात, पुढील 50 वर्षाचा विचार करून या तीर्थक्षेत्राच्या ठिकाणी करण्यात येणारी विकासकामे येत्या 30 महिन्यात पूर्ण करावीत, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस म्हणाले, पंढरपूर हे राज्यातील महत्त्वाचे धार्मिक व सांस्कृतिक तीर्थक्षेत्र आहे. येथे दरवर्षी आषाढी, कार्तिकी, चैत्री आणि माघी वारीच्या काळात लाखो वारकरी श्री विठ्ठल-रुक्मिणी यांच्या दर्शनासाठी येतात. भाविकांची सातत्याने वाढणारी संख्या, रस्ते, वाहतूक आणि अन्य संबंधित बाबी लक्षात घेता पंढरपूर तीर्थक्षेत्र परिसराच्या समग्र व नियोजित विकासाची कामे वेगाने हाती घेण्यात यावीत. पंढरपूर येथे येणाऱ्या वारकरी व भाविकांना स्वच्छ, गर्दीमुक्त, सुरक्षित आणि आध्यात्मिकदृष्ट्या समाधानकारक अनुभव मिळावा, हा विचार करून दर्जेदार विकासकामे, शाश्वत व भविष्याभिमुख पायाभूत सुविधा उभारणे आवश्यक आहे. यासाठी बाधित निवासी व व्यावसायिक मालमत्ताधारक तसेच भाडेकरूंना योग्य मोबदला तात्काळ देण्यात यावा. भूसंपादनासाठी आवश्यक निधीही त्वरित उपलब्ध करून द्यावा, अशा सूचनाही मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी दिल्या. यावेळी उपमुख्यमंत्री अजित पवार, मंत्री गणेश नाईक, मंत्री जयकुमार गोरे, आमदार समाधान आवताडे आणि वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @SunetraA_Pawar @NaikSpeaks @Jaykumar_Gore @samadhanautade1 #Maharashtra #DevendraFadnavis #Pandharpur #TeerthKshetra

म्हणाले, सामान्य नागरिकांचे जीवन सुलभ करणे हे तंत्रज्ञानाचे अंतिम उद्दिष्ट आहे. सर्वसामान्य माणूस हाच आपला ‘विठ्ठल’ असून, त्याच्या सेवेसाठीच ‘टेक वारी’ आहे. केवळ तंत्रज्ञान नव्हे, तर मानवी संवेदना, मानसिक आरोग्य, आत्मपरीक्षण आणि ‘आर्ट ऑफ हँडलिंग क्रिटिसिझम’ हे विषयही प्रशासनासाठी महत्त्वाचे आहेत. सामान्य प्रशासन विभागाच्या ‘टेक वारी’ उपक्रमाच्या माध्यमातून राज्यात नागरिक-केंद्रित प्रशासनाचा वेगवान रोडमॅप राबविला जात असून, तंत्रज्ञानाच्या सहाय्याने शासन अधिक कार्यक्षम आणि सुलभ करण्यावर भर दिला जात आहे. प्रशासनात तंत्रज्ञानाचा प्रभावी वापर करून नागरिकांचे जीवन अधिक सुलभ करण्यासाठी ‘टेक वारी’ हा उपक्रम आहे. ‘टेक वारी’ ही संकल्पना वारीच्या सातत्यपूर्ण परंपरेप्रमाणेच प्रेरणादायी आहे. जसे वारकरी कोणत्याही परिस्थितीत पंढरपूरची वारी चुकवत नाहीत, तसेच आजच्या वेगाने बदलणाऱ्या तंत्रज्ञानाच्या युगात सातत्याने शिकणे अत्यावश्यक आहे. अक्षरज्ञानापासून इंटरनेटपर्यंत साक्षरतेची व्याख्या विकसित झाली असून, आता ती एआयपर्यंत पोहोचली आहे. ज्याला एआय समजते आणि वापरता येते, तोच खऱ्या अर्थाने आज साक्षर आहे, असे प्रतिपादन मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी यावेळी केले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, एआयमुळे नोकरीच्या स्वरूपात मोठे बदल होणार असून, पुढील 1000 दिवसांत 80 ते 90 टक्के कामकाजाचे Modern shipping doesn't just run on fuel and steel. It runs on insurance. And right now, India controls almost none of it. A new paper by Mayank Mishra and John J Vachaparambil of the National Maritime Foundation breaks open a topic that rarely makes headlines in Indian policy circles — marine insurance and P&I Clubs — and why India's dependence on foreign institutions is a serious strategic vulnerability. The numbers are stark. 90% of the world's ocean-going tonnage is covered by just 12 P&I Clubs, all operating out of London. India has no presence in this system — and pays heavily for it. The paper argues that high insurance rates can effectively deter vessel traffic from conflict zones. For a country with growing maritime ambitions, that's not just a business problem. It's a national security one. India has tried before — in 2012 and 2018 — and both attempts fell short. The authors lay out why, and what a credible national P&I Club would actually require: regulatory reform, public-private collaboration, and a phased approach starting at GIFT City. The question the paper leaves you with is sharp: should India pursue a national P&I Club as a commercial venture — or as a strategic maritime policy instrument? A lot of the responses to this image have used it to argue that China had the technology to explore the world, chose not to, and thereby missed the great age of European expansion through cultural sclerosis or bureaucratic timidity. The argument has the comparative outcome right, but the structural picture it implies is wrong, and the actual story is more interesting than Twitter's little morality play would suggest. Zheng He was a Muslim eunuch admiral of the Yongle Emperor of the Ming dynasty, who between 1405 and 1433 (the original poster say "14th century", which is wrong) led seven enormous diplomatic-tributary expeditions across the Indian Ocean to Southeast Asia, India, Arabia, and the East African coast. The voyages involved fleets of over 250 ships and 27,000 personnel, with the largest treasure ships running probably 200 to 250 feet long, several times larger than anything contemporary Europe was building. The purpose wasn't commercial. The voyages were prestige projects designed to enroll foreign rulers in the Ming tribute system, with the Chinese state distributing more wealth in gifts than it received back. They projected the Yongle Emperor's status as the cosmic center of a world order that extended to the African coast, and they were one element in his broader program of grand imperial assertion that included the construction of Beijing as the new capital and the campaigns against the Mongols. After Zheng He's death on his seventh voyage, the program was discontinued. The largest treasure ships were broken up, the shipyards were closed, and the technical knowledge of building vessels at that scale was lost within a generation. The standard explanation for this is that Confucian officials, suspicious of foreign contact and hostile to the eunuchs running the program, persuaded the emperor to abandon it. The actual reasoning, though, was less ideological. The voyages cost enormous sums and did not produce an economic return commensurate with their cost. The empire's strategic threat lay overland on the Mongolian steppe, where naval power was useless, and the post-Yongle state was already running deficits the agricultural tax base could not sustain. The bureaucracy that argued against the voyages was making a budgetary case rather than a cultural one. The Tumu Crisis of 1449, in which the emperor was personally captured by Mongols at a battle the Ming should have won, vindicated the people who had argued that the empire's military attention needed to be on the steppe. The deeper question is why the Ming did not subsequently develop a global navy and colonize the world the way the European states would. The answer is structural rather than cultural. The European maritime expansion was driven by Ottoman closure of land routes to Asia, by the search for precious metals to fund European debt, by Christian missionary imperatives, and above all by competitive pressure among rival European states forced to match each other's overseas capabilities. None of these conditions obtained in the Chinese case. China already had access to the goods Europeans were crossing the oceans for. It had no debt crisis overseas gold could solve. It had no missionary religion. And it had no rival of comparable resources whose maritime expansion would have forced China to respond. For the Ming to have undertaken European-style colonization would have been the strategic equivalent of Rome at its height pivoting to Atlantic exploration. The technology was available but the incentives were not. The framing that China was sclerotic for not colonizing the world treats European maritime imperialism as the default trajectory any healthy civilization would have taken. The reverse framing is at least as defensible: European colonization was the response of small, capital-poor, militarily-pressured peripheral states under specific competitive and ideological conditions, with consequences the responding states themselves often could not predict or control. China's continental imperial form, sustained for two thousand years across multiple dynasties, is the historical norm. European maritime imperialism is the historical anomaly. The Ming made a defensible decision to remain the historical norm. به نام خداوند جان و خرد گرگ‌ها همراه و انسان‌ها غریب با که باید گفت این حال عجیب؟ در روزگاری که مردم ما بیش از هر زمان دیگری مصداق این بیت شاعر شهیر ایران‌زمین، فریدون مشیری اند و طعم تلخ پراکندگی، بی‌اعتمادی و فشار را می‌چشند، روشن است که کسانی که راه، آرمان و درد مشترک دارند، باید در کنار هم بایستند. امروز افغانستان در وضعیتی قرار دارد که بیش از هر زمان دیگر به همدلی، درک متقابل و ایستادگی مشترک نیاز دارد از همین رو، ضمن نکوهش تلاش‌های مغرضانه و تفرقه‌افکنانه برخی حلقه‌های تخریب‌گر، حمایت و قدردانی خود را از تلاش‌ها و موضع‌گیری‌های خواهر مبارز و گرامی ما، بانو فوزیه کوفی، اعلام می‌کنم. سرزمین ما سال‌هاست که زخم‌های عمیق و رنج‌های بی‌شماری را تحمل می‌کند؛ زخم‌هایی که بسیاری از آن‌ها نه تنها از دشمن بیرونی، بلکه از شکاف‌ها و جدایی‌هایی برخاسته‌اند که در میان خود ما پدید آمده‌اند. امروز بیش از هر زمان دیگر نیاز داریم که فراتر از نام‌ها، زبان‌ها و تعلقات قومی بایستیم و به این حقیقت روشن بازگردیم که افغانستان خانه مشترک همه ماست. برای رسیدن به افغانستانی آزاد، عاری از ظلم، استبداد و بی‌عدالتی، همه ما، از هر قوم و زبان و مذهبی که باشیم، به یکدیگر نیاز داریم. پس باید با هوشیاری از دام اختلاف و فاصله دوری کنیم، دست در دست هم بگذاریم و بر هدف اصلی خود، که آزادی کشور و رهایی مردم ماست، متمرکز بمانیم.

【買取業務に関するご報告とお詫び】 本日、当店にて買取をご利用いただいたお客様より、「提出したカードが足りない」とのご指摘をいただきました。お客様は7枚提出されたとお申し出いただきましたが、当店側では当時5枚しか確認できず、査定担当者も「そのカードは見ていない」と回答いたしました。 その後、受付担当が防犯カメラの映像確認を提案し、査定担当者が該当の映像を確認。映っていた場面を写真で撮影し、お客様に提示いたしましたが、その映像には5枚しか映っていないように見えました。 その時点で受付担当は「映像で5枚しか確認できないため、納得いただけない場合は警察を呼んでご確認いただいた方が良いのでは」とお伝えしました。この発言はお客様への不信を前提としたものではありませんでしたが、結果として高圧的に受け取られかねないものであり、深く反省しております。 一度はお客様より「納得した」とのお言葉をいただきましたが、その数時間後「やはり足りないので再確認してほしい」とのご連絡をいただきました。PSAの鑑定番号も添えていただき、改めてより広い範囲の映像を確認したところ、お客様が査定物を出す準備の段階において、確かに7枚のカードをお出しになっていたことが確認されました。 結果として、査定担当者が7枚中5枚のみを査定し、残りの2枚を誤って査定済み用のケースに収納していたことが原因であったことが判明しました。このミスにより、お客様に不信感とご迷惑をおかけしてしまったことを、深くお詫び申し上げます。 今回の件では以下のような点が、お客様の信頼を損なう結果につながってしまいました： ①防犯映像が5枚に見えたという理由のみで、お客様のご申告を否定してしまったこと （映像には角度や映り方による限界があり、確定的な判断材料とすべきではありませんでした） ②「警察を呼びますか」といった対応が、誠実さではなく威圧と受け取られるような表現になってしまったこと ③映像確認の範囲が不十分で、カード提出の準備段階を確認していなかったこと （結果として「十分に確認もしていないのに、否定された」と感じさせてしまった可能性があります） お客様の大切なお品物をお預かりする立場として、あるまじき対応だったと真摯に受け止めております。 今後は以下のような再発防止策を徹底し、同様のことが起こらぬよう努めてまいります。 ・査定時のカード枚数を受付・査定・返却の各段階で必ず記録・照合 ・映像確認は受付〜準備段階〜査定開始までを通して行うことを明文化 このたびは、お客様に多大なご不快とご心配をおかけし、誠に申し訳ございませんでした。 今後とも誠実な対応と改善に努めてまいります。

Practical assistance offered to the disadvantaged allows them to experience God’s love, and opens a path for them to enter into a lasting relationship with God. At the same time, it enables us to come into contact with the flesh of Christ by seeking to see and serve Him in our brothers and sisters (cf. Mt 25:31-46). In this way, our works of charity become a mutual encounter with the Lord who is present among us.

“Have faith,” Jesus tells us in the #GospelOfTheDay (Jn 14:1). That is the secret! It is precisely this faith that frees our hearts from the anxiety of possessing and acquiring, and from the illusion that we must pursue a position of prestige to have worth. Each person already has infinite worth in the mystery of God.

Park Narodowy Ujście Warty to jeden z najcenniejszych przyrodniczych skarbów Polski. To żywy, pulsujący ekosystem, w którym natura ma głos tysięcy ptaków. Na tym obszarze spotkać można ponad 280 gatunków, w tym ponad 170 lęgowych. Wiele z nich należy do gatunków zagrożonych w skali globalnej. To gęsi, kaczki, perkozy, czaple czy bataliony. Tu mieszkają też między innymi małe i niesamowite gatunki takie jak wodniczka, podróżniczek czy wąsatka. By lepiej je chronić tworzymy strefę ochronną, w części otuliny Parku Narodowego „Ujście Warty”. Bufor obejmie tereny, na których ryzyko szkód rolniczych jest minimalne. Szerokość strefy zależeć będzie od rozmieszczenia ptasich siedlisk. Właśnie podpisałam rozporządzenie, które wejdzie w życie za 30 dni.

We instrumented Endurance with accelerometers at key locations, then applied a small sinusoidal force through a sting shaker to excite the vehicle's natural frequencies and mode shapes. This was the structural data we needed to ensure lander safety at launch. The data we collected did two things: it proved Endurance won't dynamically interact with New Glenn's low-frequency body modes during launch and it validated our structural model with real-world test data. This also marked the first integration of Endurance, the flight New Glenn separation system, and a flight-equivalent GS2 payload adapter stacked together, making the configuration as flight-like as possible. Blue Origin (@blueorigin) Endurance is going through a variety of tests ahead of launch in Florida. First one complete: modal testing ✅ We used sensors to measure how our lunar lander will respond to launch conditions. Modern shipping doesn't just run on fuel and steel. It runs on insurance. And right now, India controls almost none of it. A new paper by Mayank Mishra and John J Vachaparambil of the National Maritime Foundation breaks open a topic that rarely makes headlines in Indian policy circles — marine insurance and P&I Clubs — and why India's dependence on foreign institutions is a serious strategic vulnerability. The numbers are stark. 90% of the world's ocean-going tonnage is covered by just 12 P&I Clubs, all operating out of London. India has no presence in this system — and pays heavily for it. The paper argues that high insurance rates can effectively deter vessel traffic from conflict zones. For a country with growing maritime ambitions, that's not just a business problem. It's a national security one. India has tried before — in 2012 and 2018 — and both attempts fell short. The authors lay out why, and what a credible national P&I Club would actually require: regulatory reform, public-private collaboration, and a phased approach starting at GIFT City. The question the paper leaves you with is sharp: should India pursue a national P&I Club as a commercial venture — or as a strategic maritime policy instrument? Thongsavan Phomvihane was received by Secretary-General of ASEAN Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, Deputy Secretaries-General of ASEAN and the Committee of Permanent Representatives (CPRs). During the visit, H.E. Thongsavan Phomvihane presented a finely crafted rosewood carving of Laos’ Iconic Landmarks to the ASEAN Secretariat, which will be housed in the ASEAN Gallery. H.E. Thongsavan Phomvihane also held an interface with Dr. Kao and the CPRs to discuss ASEAN priorities, regional and international developments, and ongoing Community-building efforts.

At the invitation of H.E. Ferdinand R. Marcos, Jr., President of the Republic of the Philippines and Chair of ASEAN in 2026, Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, will lead the ASEAN Secretariat Delegation to participate in the 48th ASEAN Summit and Related Meetings, to be held on 6 to 8 May 2026, in Cebu, the Philippines, under the theme “Navigating Our Future, Together.” Prior to the ASEAN Summit, SG Dr. Kao will also participate in a series of ministerial meetings, including the ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM), the 31st ASEAN Political-Security Community (APSC) Council Meeting, the 38th ASEAN Coordinating Council (ACC) Meeting, and the ASEAN Joint Foreign and Economic Ministers’ Meeting. Global telecom networks hijacked for mass surveillance by Israeli firms —— Israeli telecommunications infrastructure has been used to track mobile phone users across more than 10 countries over the past three years, according to an investigation by Canada-based digital research group Citizen Lab, cited by Haaretz. The probe found that systems spanning legacy networks and modern 5G architecture were effectively turned into “tracking devices” using advanced spyware tools, with over 15,700 location-tracking attempts recorded since November 2022 across countries including Thailand, South Africa, Norway, Bangladesh, and Malaysia. Internal documents reviewed by Haaretz showed that Israel-linked firms marketed and deployed surveillance tools globally. Verint, the parent company of Cognyte, reportedly sold an SS7-based system known as SkyLock to a government client in the Democratic Republic of Congo, while Swiss telecom firm Fink enabled Israeli companies such as Rayzone to impersonate mobile carriers and infiltrate networks. The investigation found that core global telecom systems used to route calls, texts, and mobile data across networks were exploited to extract user data, including through SIMjacking, which uses hidden SMS messages to force devices to share their location.

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 today received the Deputy Foreign Minister of Norway, H.E. Mr. Andreas Motzfeldt Kravik, at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. The two sides held discussions on the evolving regional situation. DPM/FM underscored Pakistan’s continued efforts to promote engagement and dialogue for peace and stability in the region and beyond. Mr. Kravik reiterated Norway’s support for Pakistan’s constructive role and its ongoing efforts toward a peaceful and durable resolution of the conflict. Both sides also explored avenues to further strengthen bilateral relations and deepen engagement across diverse sectors of mutual interest. Mr. Kravik conveyed an invitation from the Norwegian Foreign Minister to DPM/FM to participate in the Oslo Forum scheduled for next month. DPM/FM expressed appreciation for the invitation. Both sides agreed to remain in close contact on bilateral matters, and issues relating to peace, stability, and development.

Pleased to announce that twenty-two crew members from the seized Iranian container vessel, “MV Touska”, have been safely evacuated to Pakistan. The individuals were safely flown in Pakistan last night and will be transferred to Iran today. The Iranian ship is also being backloaded to Pakistani territorial waters for its return to its original owners after necessary repairs. These actions are being coordinated with the support of both the Iranian and the US authorities and surely constitute an important confidence-building measure. Pakistan expresses its appreciation to the United States and Iran, and remains committed to facilitating dialogue, diplomacy, and mediation for the regional peace and security.

Warren Buffett just warned that the US dollar could collapse and admitted he doesn't understand most of the stock market anymore. 95 years old, sitting on $380 billion in cash, and the first time watching from the sidelines instead of actively investing. And what he revealed at this weekend's Berkshire shareholder meeting is genuinely concerning: On the market, Buffett didn't hold back. He compared it to "a church with a casino attached" and said the casino has never been more packed. On one-day options: "That is not investing. It's not speculating. It's gambling. Totally." He pointed to the Avis short squeeze THIS WEEK. A rental car company that's been around for 50 years getting meme-squeezed in 2026. The same behavior that blew up retail traders with GameStop is back, except now it's hitting boring legacy companies with zero business being volatile. "We have lots more regulation now, but people spend their time figuring out how to get around the rules rather than follow the rules." That one sentence explains more about the current market than every CNBC segment combined. When asked why he's hoarding $380 billion instead of investing it, Buffett said something no one expected: "I understand fewer of the businesses as a percentage of the whole than I did 10 years ago. I have not learned new industries for some years. I'm not going to have an edge on a whole bunch of younger people that have actually grown up with it." Think about what he's actually saying... This is a man who made $140 billion by understanding businesses better than anyone alive. And he's telling you the current market is so detached from reality that even HE can't make sense of what's being valued and why. He quoted IBM's Tom Watson Sr.: "I'm smart in spots and I stay around those spots." In 60 years of managing money, he said MAYBE five were "really juicy." Five out of sixty. That means 92% of his career was spent WAITING while everyone else gambled. And he still ended up richer than all of them. Then the conversation turned to inflation and that's where it gets really interesting: Buffett said America is "not immune" from runaway inflation. He brought up countries that went bankrupt "six or seven times" in his lifetime. Compared today to right before Volcker had to rescue the dollar, when Americans were borrowing at 12% to buy farmland earning 6% because they believed the dollar would disappear. "Cash is trash" was the mentality. Nebraska farmers collapsed because of it. Entire communities wiped out not by a recession but by a BELIEF that the currency was dying. And Buffett sees that same energy building again. Then someone asked the question everyone wanted answered: Do you see a crash coming? "If you saw it coming, it wouldn't happen. The things people are talking about and thinking about? It's not going to happen. But there are things that can come out of the blue." He compared it to the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand in 1914 that triggered World War I. Nobody was discussing or anticipating it. But it changed the world overnight. "That's particularly true now because of the things that can come out of the sky." A 95yo man who has survived every crash, every war, every crisis of the last six decades just told you the market is a casino, the dollar isn't safe, and the real collapse will be something nobody sees coming. $380 billion in cash is his answer because he believes things are about to get much worse. It was an honour to speak at the International Conference on “Contribution of Himalayan Buddhism to the Spiritual and Cultural Heritage of India and Beyond” held at the Mahabodhi International Meditation Centre in Leh. My message was simple: We often define a nation’s strength by its borders, infrastructure, and material capabilities. While vital, these are only the outer shell. True strength is quieter, deeper, and more enduring; it is the strength of culture and identity. For centuries, Himalayan Buddhism has been the heartbeat of our frontier regions. It is more than a spiritual path, it is a civilizational anchor. True security is not only built with defences, but with the enduring power of culture, community, and conviction.

UK prime minister Keir Starmer is under fire after remarks critics say deliberately blur the line between Jewish identity and the actions of the Israeli state, while also smearing peaceful pro-Palestine protests by associating them with unrelated violence. Palestine Solidarity Campaign (PSC) deputy director Peter Leary, speaking to Sky News, said the prime minister’s comments were “extremely irresponsible”, accusing him of pushing a false narrative on two fronts: equating Jewish people with Israel, and linking mass anti-genocide demonstrations with isolated violent incidents. Referring to events in Golders Green, Leary said there is “no connection whatsoever” between those incidents and the protests that have seen hundreds of thousands take to the streets. He highlighted that the marches consistently include large numbers of Jewish participants, many openly organising and marching as part of Jewish blocs, directly undermining Starmer’s framing. Leary stressed the movement’s message is clear and unchanged: opposition to Israel’s genocide against Palestinians, demands for an arms embargo and sanctions. Video

In the Bureij refugee camp in Gaza, 26-year-old artist Areej al-Saafin stands before walls filled with charcoal drawings of eyes, each one shaped by loss. She lost her own eye in an Israeli airstrike, a moment that reshaped not only her vision but her entire life. "I was injured in the war and lost my eye," she says, describing how blurred sight now follows every line she draws. With no materials left after her home and artwork were destroyed, she burns wood to make charcoal, even recalling how she and her family were forced to burn clothes and remaining belongings just to cook. Her art has narrowed, becoming more personal and more raw. "Before the war, I used to draw more broadly, but after my injury, I only draw eyes," she says, her work now reflecting what she calls the anger and suffering surrounding her. "I am still only 26 years old, a girl who just wants to live her life normally," she adds. "But this suffering has buried me alive." Video

.@WHO is working closely with Member States and a ship’s operators in response to suspected cases of hantavirus detected onboard a cruise liner. WHO is facilitating medical evacuation of two symptomatic passengers, conducting a full risk assessment, and supporting affected people onboard. Rapid, coordinated action is critical to contain risks and protect public health. World Health Organization (WHO) (@WHO) WHO is aware of and supporting a public health event involving a cruise vessel sailing in the Atlantic Ocean. To date, one case of hantavirus infection has been laboratory confirmed, and there are five additional suspected cases. Of the six affected individuals, three have died and one is currently in intensive care in South Africa. Detailed investigations are ongoing, including further laboratory testing, and epidemiological investigations. Medical care and support are being provided to passengers and crew. Sequencing of the virus is also ongoing. Hantavirus infections are typically linked to environmental exposure (exposure to infected rodents’ urine or faeces). While rare, hantavirus may spread between people, and can lead to severe respiratory illness and requires careful patient monitoring, support and response. WHO is facilitating coordination between Member States and the Ship’s operators for medical evacuation of two symptomatic passengers, as well as full public health risk assessment and support to the remaining passengers on board. WHO is grateful for the rapid actions and coordination. Detailed investigations are ongoing, including further laboratory testing, and epidemiological investigations. Medical care and support are being provided to passengers and crew. Sequencing of the virus is also ongoing. Hantavirus infections are typically linked to environmental exposure (exposure to infected rodents’ urine or faeces). While rare, hantavirus may spread between people, and can lead to severe respiratory illness and requires careful patient monitoring, support and response. WHO is facilitating coordination between Member States and the Ship’s operators for medical evacuation of two symptomatic passengers, as well as full public health risk assessment and support to the remaining passengers on board. WHO is grateful for the rapid actions and coordination. We have informed our National Focal Points according to the International Health Regulations and a Disease Outbreak News for the public will be issued.

JetBlue is exploding at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International—adding 11 brand new cities, extra flights on existing routes, and pushing nearly 130 daily departures this summer. That's a 75%+ jump from last year and their biggest FLL operation EVER. CEO Joanna Geraghty put it plainly: "South Florida is a key market... we're stepping up, adding service, and keeping fares competitive." (Translation: we're taking over.) Fun fact? Fort Lauderdale was JetBlue's very first destination back in 2000. Now they're reclaiming it after Spirit held 27% of that market. Oh, and they're not leaving Spirit's crew behind either—jumpseat access for two weeks and job interviews for qualified staff. This is how you turn a market collapse into a masterclass. 👇

On World Press Freedom Day, we thank every journalist, photographer, fixer, editor, and media worker who continues to tell the world the truth about Ukraine. Ukrainian and foreign journalists document Russia's war crimes, report from frontline cities, and preserve the stories of people living through this war. Many risk their lives to make sure the truth is seen and heard. Some have paid for it with their freedom or their lives. This year, Ukraine rose seven places in the World Press Freedom Index by Reporters Without Borders, reaching 55th place among 180 countries. Since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion, Ukraine has climbed 50 positions in the ranking. At the same time, Russia continues persecuting journalists for doing their work, with 26 Ukrainian media workers currently held captive. They must be released and returned home. Free journalism is one of the most powerful tools against propaganda, disinformation and attempts to hide the truth. Thank you to everyone who continues to report, document, investigate and speak up.

Alors que les rivalités autour du détroit de Bab-el-Mandeb s’accentuent, cet article explique la centralité stratégique de Mayyun, devenue un point de rivalité décisif entre acteurs régionaux et internationaux. turkish intelligence (@turkish_intell) Mayyun Island: a discreet strategic chokepoint at the heart of major rivalries in the Red Sea Mayyun Island, located at the heart of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, is now emerging as a pivotal node in the strategic rivalries shaping the Red Sea. This volcanic outcrop is drawing increasing attention from regional and international powers due to its capacity to control, or disrupt, one of the world’s most critical maritime trade routes. Since early April, several Western intelligence services have requested satellite imagery acquisitions from Airbus Defence and Space, specifically targeting Mayyun. This renewed interest comes amid heightened tensions between anti-Houthi factions, particularly between the internationally recognized Yemeni government (backed by Riyadh) and forces affiliated with Tareq Saleh, nephew of Ali Abdullah Saleh. Long supported by Abu Dhabi, Tareq Saleh is now attracting Washington’s attention, signaling a possible realignment of external backing. A revealing episode illustrates these frictions: on April 1, military transport aircraft reportedly attempted to land on the island but were prevented from doing so by pro-Saudi forces. While this account was officially denied, OSINT analyses nevertheless confirmed the suspicious passage, the previous evening, of an Ilyushin Il-76 (registration TL-ATD), which circled above Mayyun before heading back toward Africa. The aircraft is operated by Invicta Air Cargo, a Central African company with structural ties to Emirati security networks, notably through Gewan Holding, which is close to Hamdan bin Zayed al-Nahyan, brother of President Mohammed bin Zayed al-Nahyan. Technical connections between the two entities (including the reuse of digital infrastructure and transfers of aviation assets) suggest operational continuity. Notably, a few days after flying over Mayyun, the aircraft traveled from Fujairah to the Israeli Nevatim airbase, pointing to broader, and potentially coordinated, logistical circuits. On the ground, the control dynamics over the island have evolved. Initially, Abu Dhabi had been developing discreet air infrastructure there, progress of which was still visible in commercial satellite imagery in 2025. However, since early 2026, the UAE appears to have withdrawn. This shift is part of a broader reassertion of control by Riyadh over local forces (notably those of the Southern Transitional Council), thereby consolidating its direct influence. Currently, control of Mayyun rests on a combination of Tareq Saleh’s forces and a significant Saudi contingent, particularly deployed around the island’s airstrip. However, the aforementioned aerial incident suggests that coordination between these actors remains imperfect, if not openly strained. Moreover, several local sources indicate a deepening of security cooperation between Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Israel on the island. Narratives disseminated by the Houthis had already, as early as February, pointed to joint projects aimed at transforming Mayyun into a forward strategic platform. The objective appears clear: to establish a foothold capable of containing, or countering, any attempt by the Iran-backed Houthis to blockade the strait, echoing recurring tensions in the Strait of Hormuz. Finally, the gradual withdrawal of the UAE from its insular positions in Yemen (notably Socotra and Mayyun) now seems nearly complete. According to several security sources, their last active foothold would be Abd al-Kuri Island in the Indian Ocean, marking a strategic repositioning in response to Saudi Arabia’s growing assertiveness. In sum, Mayyun stands out as a true geostrategic chokepoint, where intra-coalition rivalries, shifting alliances, and power projection dynamics converge. Control over this small island far exceeds its size: it directly shapes the security balance of a maritime corridor that is vital on a global scale. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/turkish_intell/status/2047310600368230638#m
